name: accounting.reconciliation
description: Reconcile Stripe payments with the financial ledger. Matches every real Stripe charge to a journal entry and bank transaction. Flags mismatches.

steps.name: Fetch unreconciled Stripe transactions
steps.query: SELECT id, stripe_payment_intent_id, real_amount, net_amount, enrollment_type, created_at FROM fin_stripe_bridge WHERE reconciled = false AND status = 'completed' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50

steps.name: Verify trial balance
steps.query: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit), 0) as total_debits, COALESCE(SUM(credit), 0) as total_credits, ABS(COALESCE(SUM(debit), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(credit), 0)) as imbalance FROM fin_journal_lines jl JOIN fin_journal_entries je ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id AND je.is_posted = true

steps.name: Check bank account balances vs ledger
steps.query: SELECT ba.account_name, ba.current_balance as bank_balance, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN coa.normal_balance = 'debit' THEN jl.debit - jl.credit ELSE jl.credit - jl.debit END), 0) as ledger_balance FROM fin_bank_accounts ba LEFT JOIN fin_chart_of_accounts coa ON ba.coa_account = coa.account_number LEFT JOIN fin_journal_lines jl ON coa.account_number = jl.account_number LEFT JOIN fin_journal_entries je ON jl.journal_entry_id = je.id AND je.is_posted = true WHERE ba.is_active = true GROUP BY ba.account_name, ba.current_balance, coa.normal_balance

steps.name: Generate reconciliation report
